sentences.en: There has always been an interest in geniuses and prodigies.
sentences.zh: 一直以来,人们都对天才和天才感兴趣。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The word ‘genius’, from the Latin gens (= family) and the term ‘genius’, meaning ‘begetter’, comes from the early Roman cult of a divinity as the head of the family.
sentences.zh: 拉丁人(=家庭)的“天才”一词和“天才”一词,意思是“更好的”一词,来自罗马人早期将神灵视为一家之主的神灵崇拜。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In its earliest form, genius was concerned with the ability of the head of the family, the paterfamilias, to perpetuate himself.
sentences.zh: 最早的天才们关心的是一家之主即贵族能否让自己长久生存下去

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Gradually, genius came to represent a person’s characteristics and thence an individual’s highest attributes derived from his ‘genius’ or guiding spirit.
sentences.zh: 天才逐渐代表一个人的特征, 因而个人的最高品质来自他的“天才”或指导精神。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Today, people still look to stars or genes, astrology or genetics, in the hope of finding the source of exceptional abilities or personal characteristics.
sentences.zh: 今天,人们仍然在寻找恒星或基因、占星学或遗传学,希望找到特殊能力或个人特征的来源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The concept of genius and of gifts has become part of our folk culture, and attitudes are ambivalent towards them.
sentences.zh: 天才和礼品的概念已成为我们民间文化的一部分,对之的态度是矛盾的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We envy the gifted and mistrust them.
sentences.zh: 我们羡慕天赋者,并不信任他们。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the mythology of giftedness, it is popularly believed that if people are talented in one area, they must be defective in another, that intellectuals are impractical, that prodigies burn too brightly too soon and burn out, that gifted people are eccentric, that they are physical weaklings, that there’s a thin line between genius and madness, that genius runs in families, that the gifted are so clever they don’t need special help, that giftedness is the same as having a high IQ, that some races are more intelligent or musical or mathematical than others, that genius goes unrecognised and unrewarded, that adversity makes men wise or that people with gifts have a responsibility to use them.
sentences.zh: 在天赋神话中,人们普遍相信,如果人们在某一领域有才华,那么他们必定在另一个领域有缺陷,知识分子是不切实际的,知识分子烧得太快,发烧太快,发光太快,发光的人是异端,他们是体弱者,天才和疯狂者之间有细微的界限,天才在家庭中运行,天才不需要特别帮助,天才不需要特别帮助,天赋分子与智商高一样,天赋分子比其他种族更聪明,音乐或数学水平更高,天才得不到认可和奖励,逆境使男人变得聪明,或有天赋的人有责任使用这些智慧。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Language has been enriched with such terms as ‘highbrow’, ‘egghead’, ‘blue-stocking’, ‘wiseacre’, ‘know-all’, ‘boffin’ and, for many, ‘intellectual’ is a term of denigration.
sentences.zh: 语言已经丰富, 诸如 " 高写 " 、 " egghead " 、 " 蓝股票 " 、 " 智者 " 、 " 万事皆知 " 、 " 猪肉 " 等术语,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The nineteenth century saw considerable interest in the nature of genius, and produced not a few studies of famous prodigies.
sentences.zh: 十九世纪对天才的性质表现出相当大的兴趣,并且没有对著名的天才进行一些研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Perhaps for us today, two of the most significant aspects of most of these studies of genius are the frequency with which early encouragement and teaching by parents and tutors had beneficial effects on the intellectual, artistic or musical development of the children but caused great difficulties of adjustment later in their lives, and the frequency with which abilities went unrecognised by teachers and schools.
sentences.zh: 也许对我们今天来说,大多数这类天才研究的两个最重要的方面是父母和教师早期鼓励和教学对儿童智力、艺术或音乐发展产生有益影响,但在其以后生活中造成很大的调整困难的频率,以及教师和学校不承认能力的情况。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: However, the difficulty with the evidence produced by these studies, fascinating as they are in collecting together anecdotes and apparent similarities and exceptions, is that they are not what we would today call norm-referenced.
sentences.zh: 然而,这些研究所产生的证据令人着迷,因为它们在收集各种杂念以及明显的相似性和例外方面令人着迷,很难理解这些研究所产生的证据,这是因为它们不是我们今天称之为规范参照的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In other words, when, for instance, information is collated about early illnesses, methods of upbringing, schooling, etc., we must also take into account information from other historical sources about how common or exceptional these were at the time.
sentences.zh: 换言之,例如,在整理早期疾病、养育方法、学校教育等信息时,我们还必须考虑其他历史来源提供的关于这些疾病在当时有多常见或特殊的信息。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

words.def: 信息信息信息信息信息信息信息

sentences.en: For instance, infant mortality was high and life expectancy much shorter than today, home tutoring was common in the families of the nobility and wealthy, bullying and corporal punishment were common at the best independent schools and, for the most part, the cases studied were members of the privileged classes.
sentences.zh: 例如,婴儿死亡率很高,预期寿命比现在短得多,在贵族和富人家庭,家庭辅导很常见,在最好的独立学校,欺凌和体罚很常见,所研究的案件大多是特权阶层的成员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: It was only with the growth of paediatrics and psychology in the twentieth century that studies could be carried out on a more objective, if still not always very scientific, basis.
sentences.zh: 只有随着儿科和心理学在二十世纪的发展,才能在更客观、甚至始终不十分科学的基础上进行研究。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Geniuses, however they are defined, are but the peaks which stand out through the mist of history and are visible to the particular observer from his or her particular vantage point.
sentences.zh: 不论如何定义,天才只是那些在历史迷雾中显赫的峰值,从他或她的特长点看,特定观察员能看见这些峰值。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Change the observers and the vantage points, clear away some of the mist, and a different lot of peaks appear.
sentences.zh: 改变观察者及有利点, 清除一些雾, 并出现许多不同的峰值。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Genius is a term we apply to those whom we recognise for their outstanding achievements and who stand near the end of the continuum of human abilities which reaches back through the mundane and mediocre to the incapable.
sentences.zh: 天才是一个术语,我们适用于那些我们承认他们杰出成就的人,他们几乎处于人类能力的连续体的尽头,这种能力通过普通和平庸的普通而传给无能力者。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There is still much truth in Dr. Samuel Johnson’s observation, ‘The true genius is a mind of large general powers, accidentally determined to some particular direction’.
sentences.zh: 塞缪尔·约翰逊博士的观察中仍有许多真理, “真正的天才是大大国的头脑,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We may disagree with the ‘general’, for we doubt if all musicians of genius could have become scientists of genius or vice versa, but there is no doubting the accidental determination which nurtured or triggered their gifts into those channels into which they have poured their powers so successfully.
sentences.zh: 我们或许不同意“将军”的说法, 因为我们怀疑所有天才音乐家是否都能成为天才科学家, 或反之亦然, 但毫无疑问的是,

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Along the continuum of abilities are hundreds of thousands of gifted men and women, boys and girls.
sentences.zh: 各种能力始终是成千上万的有天赋的男女、男孩和女孩。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: What we appreciate, enjoy or marvel at in the works of genius or the achievements of prodigies are the manifestations of skills or abilities which are similar to, but so much superior to, our own.
sentences.zh: 我们欣赏、欣赏或惊叹天才作品或天才成就, 其表现形式与我们自己的技能或能力相似, 但却比我们更优越。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: But that their minds are not different from our own is demonstrated by the fact that the hard-won discoveries of scientists like Kepler or Einstein become the commonplace knowledge of schoolchildren and the once outrageous shapes and colours of an artist like Paul Klee so soon appear on the fabrics we wear.
sentences.zh: 但他们的思想与我们的思想没有不同, 这一点表现在, 诸如开普勒或爱因斯坦等科学家来之不易的发现成为学生的常识, 以及保罗·克莱这样的艺术家的令人发指的形状和颜色很快出现在我们穿的布料上。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This does not minimise the supremacy of their achievements, which outstrip our own as the sub-four-minute milers outstrip our jogging.
sentences.zh: 这不能最大限度地降低他们成就的至高无上,而他们的成就超过了我们自己的四分钟,因为四分钟的里程数超过了我们的慢跑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: To think of geniuses and the gifted as having uniquely different brains is only reasonable if we accept that each human brain is uniquely different.
sentences.zh: 将天才和天才视为有着独特不同大脑才是合理的如果我们承认每个人的大脑都与众不同

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The purpose of instruction is to make us even more different from one another, and in the process of being educated we can learn from the achievements of those more gifted than ourselves.
sentences.zh: 教学的目的是使我们彼此更加不同,在接受教育的过程中,我们可以从比我们自己更有天赋的人的成就中学习。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But before we try to emulate geniuses or encourage our children to do so we should note that some of the things we learn from them may prove unpalatable.
sentences.zh: 但在我们尝试模仿天才或鼓励我们的孩子这样做之前,我们应注意,我们从他们身上学到的一些东西可能证明是不受欢迎的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We may envy their achievements and fame, but we should also recognise the price they may have paid in terms of perseverance, single-mindedness, dedication, restrictions on their personal lives, the demands upon their energies and time, and how often they had to display great courage to preserve their integrity or to make their way to the top.
sentences.zh: 我们可能羡慕他们的成就和名声,但我们也应该承认他们可能付出的代价,包括坚持不懈、一心一意、献身精神、限制他们的个人生活、要求他们的精力和时间,以及他们经常不得不表现出巨大的勇气来维护他们的完整或走上最高台。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Genius and giftedness are relative descriptive terms of no real substance.
sentences.zh: 天才和才华是相对描述性术语并不真正物质。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We may, at best, give them some precision by defining them and placing them in a context but, whatever we do, we should never delude ourselves into believing that gifted children or geniuses are different from the rest of humanity, save in the degree to which they have developed the performance of their abilities.
sentences.zh: 我们最好通过界定他们和把它们置于一个背景来给他们一些精确性,但是,无论我们做什么,我们决不应欺骗自己,相信天才或天才与人类其他部分不同,除非他们已经发展了自己能力的表现。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
